games.name: Diving Legends
games.desc:
🌊 Welcome to Diving Legends! 🌊

Dive deeper, earn more, and become a true legend of the ocean! In Diving Legends, every meter you descend you earn money and bigger rewards. The deeper you go, the more money you earn!


❓ How To Play:
💰 Dive deeper in the depths and collect more money.
⚡ Train Your Speed, Swim faster and reach deeper zones quicker.
🤿 Increase Your Oxygen, Stay underwater longer.
🔧 Upgrade Your Gear, Improve your equipment to survive extreme depths.
🏆 Become a Legend, Compete to be the best diver on the leaderboard!


Start with basic gear and work your way down into the mysterious deep sea. Can you handle the pressure and reach the deepest point?

Dive in now and become a true Diving Legend! 👑

games.name: Movie Massacre 📼 [HORROR]
games.desc:
This game is based on a true story... ⚠️

After finishing school, you find a job working at a local VHS movie store secluded in the dense forest...
Try to survive the night shifts as the job that you thought would be easy turns into a nightmare like none other

🏆 Earn 1 completion to unlock the shack behind the movie store, and get a free weapon

🤫 There is a SECRET ending, will you unlock it?
🤝 This game can be played by 4 people, so invite your friends!
🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends with!

👍 Like + favorite the game for more stories based off real events

❓ Will you survive your night shifts at the new job...?

games.name: Roblox High School [Legacy]
games.desc:
The original Roblox High School is back! Enjoy revisiting the classic game like it was in 2014-2017. Go to class, hang out after school, explore the map, and make brand new friends here!

⚠️ FOLLOW THE RULES ⚠️
Anyone caught breaking the rules will be PERMANENTLY BANNED and CANNOT APPEAL.
This is a game for ALL AGES, so please be respectful and act appropriately so the game can be fun for everyone! If you see people severely breaking the rules, please report it to us!

Note that we don't plan on making any other major additions to the game - we want to keep it as close to the original as possible! Enjoy revisiting the past :)

games.name: PIG 64
games.desc:
DISCLAIMER: PIG 64 is what people may refer to as an ARG, and will require out-of-the-box thinking, but also travelling outside of the game for answers.

Controls:
Double Jump - Press jump twice
Float - Press jump when all other jumps are used
Roll / Dash / Long Jump - Shift (Computer), Tap (Mobile) or Left Trigger (Console)
Tool Abilities - F (Computer), Tap (Mobile) or Right Trigger (Console)
Emote - G (Computer), Tap (Mobile) or Y/Triangle (Console)
